features: Original national/regional feature groups plus rte_at_origin_mw and rte_bias_recent_mw
residual_target: actual_mw minus rte_at_origin_mw; add the predicted correction to RTE
search: Same two fast configurations per family as the independent experiment; all four chronological 2024 folds; monthly parameter fits; no random split
selection: Select each variant's configuration using pooled 2024 MAE with raw forecast availability >= 0.99; freeze best assisted variant and best complete policy across the 16 assisted and 27 original policies before new calibration/test replay
cold_guardrail: Report realized-temperature<5 C delivery hours18/19/20 separately; require >=60 hours and20 days to interpret the upper-tail diagnostic. No realized future weather enters predictors. Overall MAE improvement does not establish adequate cold-evening protection.
point_fallback: Require target-interval RTE for assisted raw predictions; if unavailable/invalid/failed, fall back to RTE, then weekly persistence, comparable-day mean, latest observation; report all availability/fallbacks
uncertainty: All policies: fixed empirical distribution of past out-of-sample calibration residuals. Quantile LightGBM: native q05/q50/q95. Best development-selected assisted variant: separate single-fit split-conformal comparator; no exchangeability or conditional guarantees
interval_policy_selection: No interval method selected from the historical test; all methods reported with method-specific labels and availability

critical_risk_scenarios.interpretation: Dimensionless weights times MW error; not euros, realized financial savings or optimal procurement

scope: Research extension in existing notebooks07/08. Neural and univariate statistical models are not silently given unsupported exogenous inputs. No production implementation.
